dmn_experiences.title: Kirkstall Brewery Tour & Tasting
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided tour of Kirkstall Brewery in Leeds led by a tasting expert, including samples of three seasonal beers and access to the taproom. Adults only.
highlights: Guided brewery tour with a tasting expert
Access to the Kirkstall Brewery Taproom

dmn_experiences.title: Cocktail Masterclass
dmn_experiences.summary: A hands-on cocktail masterclass at Dirty Martini in Leeds city centre, led by expert mixologists, with a prosecco welcome, three cocktails to make and sliders to share.
highlights: Make three cocktails with guidance from mixologists
Sliders and small plates to share
